hypothesis: Training G to cover each observed cube with one slot consistent across views improves held-out spatial grounding; action benefit must be measured separately.
control: Identical continued training with zero new objective weight
candidate: Only new objective weight 0.01; region NLL + normalized image centroid squared distance; minimum 20 current color pixels; 12-pixel dilation; one shared permutation across views
labels: Detached current RGB weak color labels, validated against renderer actor masks; no simulator coordinates, future labels, slot assignment or color pointers enter inference

fixed.optimizer: Named Adam moments retained, matched existing LR schedule continuation

preflight: migration rejects any extra online or objective change
RGB weak-label precision and coverage versus exact renderer masks
nonzero raw VJP on actual G binder and progressive visual producer parameters
unchanged outputs at restored weights and exact save/reload
pilot_selection: Always compare both final 256-update checkpoints; no selection on test scenes or evaluation seeds
measurement: same full validation scenes and seed/noise for each arm
region mass and centroid error, visibility coverage per object/camera/stage
native signed XY response in controlled placements
full 18 common closed-loop episodes per arm, no success/failure filtering
first close XY miss, red lift, transport, stack success, full NPZ/video

qualification.mechanism: held-out region mass increases and centroid error decreases relative to matched control; report per-scene results
qualification.behavior: improved close-loop reach/lift/stack outcomes; loss reduction alone does not qualify
qualification.promotion: requires successful full closed-loop trajectories and fresh seeds 6000000..6000017 after common-panel improvement

if_grounding_only_improves: Keep that result separate. Add operation-binding or native action supervision as a separate next factor with a new matched control; do not call attention improvement a repaired policy.
if_neither_improves: Reject the pilot, inspect gradient owners and weak-label/support coverage before a longer run; no automatic long training.
deferred_factors: raw_chart_v1 Teacher in its own matched arm
corrective recovery demonstrations with episode-level held-out layouts
